provenance.note: `set_entry`'s three cases: an empty slot is installed stamped `now`, the caller's `recorded_at` discarded; the same club again, or the same club with only a fresh `provenance`, is returned untouched and not written (`same_club_as`); a different club, a re-shaft or a first measured loft among them, retires the old entry stamped `now` onto the shelf. A caller's `retired_at` is cleared on install (`test_re_saving_an_unchanged_club_does_not_move_recorded_at` and the upsert tests after it)
